column1: # Spanish Cipher (1592-1593), key published by S. Tomokiyo, cryptiana "Spanish Ciphers during
# the Reign of Philip II", image henryiv-> spanish3 phelippes2.png, captioned "Spanish Cipher (1592-1593)".
# Used among Philip II, Parma, Feria, Sessa, Acuna, Olivares, Fuentes, Tassis, Ibarra, Doria and Miranda.
# --- NOMENCLATURE, from the office key BnF fr. 3995 fol. 97 (Gallica btv1b525085665, canvas 188),
# --- found via DECODE records 4076/4077 ("BNF_Français_3995_094/096", keys of Don Diego de Ibarra
# --- and the Duc de Sessa with "Le Roy Catolique"). Absent from Tomokiyo's published table.
# --- Nomenclature of BnF fr. 3995 f. 97 (canvas 188), read again from the Gallica image on 2 Oct 2026 (full-resolution crops).
# The endorsement on the back, f. 97v (canvas 189): "1592 Chifre d'entre le Duc de Parme et le Roy Cat.co en l'an 1592, lequel sert aussi pour
# le Duc de Sessa et Don Diego de Ybarre avec le Roy". f. 98 (canvas 190) is a different, French key ("Chiffre de monsieur du Maine ... 1592").
# Entries above this line came from the 19 Sept pass; those below were added or confirmed on 2 Oct (a first count of the word entries on the sheet by
# satorunet, 3 Oct, prompted the re-reading). ? = sign or word not certain. T = a T-shaped mark under the group on the sheet.
# revised on 2 Oct: the line "aduisa - ʃes" sits directly above the B block, so ʃes is aviso; the 19 Sept pass had read it as causa
